claim_rule: A new open-extra-data, same-harness point-estimate SOTA must exceed both the published number and the same-harness official checkpoint under the 400-row v2 protocol; it must not be described as a same-training-data comparison.
decision: The point-estimate rule passes. The preregistered significance rule fails because the hierarchical mIoU interval includes zero. Claims must say point-estimate SOTA and must not say statistically significant SOTA.
